title: Choo-choo train, Skippy Core's coder in one call (our incomplete harness)
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), one call with MineBench's own prompt, the way MineBench runs a model
verdict: Harness fault, found 2026-10-31: this call was not MineBench's procedure. Our copy of its prompt lacked the TOOL MODE section ("you may use ONLY these runtime globals: block, box, line, rng, Math"), and MineBench sends a failure back for up to 8 attempts where this got one. Later runs in this series give a model MineBench's way. What it did here: The fastest reply of all (94 seconds, 6,595 tokens), and it fails like the chat model, its sibling: MineBench gives the code block(), box(), line(), rng() and Math, but it redefines block() and box() on top of a voxel() function that does not exist, so the code stops at the first block. Both Qwen3.6 models invented the same missing voxel call without the TOOL MODE section.

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Skippy Core's coder slot: MTP, Q8_0)
